command: set -euo pipefail; bash scripts/run_idf.sh -B build/idf-nimble-fix-v2 -D SDKCONFIG=build/idf-nimble-fix-v2/sdkconfig -D "SDKCONFIG_DEFAULTS=config/idf/sdkconfig.defaults;config/idf/sdkconfig.defaults.n16r8" -D GROWBOX_BOARD_PROFILE=esp32s3-devkitc1-n16r8 -D GROWBOX_APP_MODE=climate-v6-real-inputs reconfigure; grep -q '^CONFIG_BT_ENABLED=y$' build/idf-nimble-fix-v2/sdkconfig; grep -q '^CONFIG_BT_NIMBLE_ENABLED=y$' build/idf-nimble-fix-v2/sdkconfig; echo NIMBLE_CONFIG_V2_PASS
